_comment: Frozen vectors. Both implementations (src/identity.ts canonical, reference/identity.py) MUST reproduce every 'expected' value byte-for-byte. Generated from the corrected implementations where Python HKDF matches TypeScript (RFC 5869 Extract+Expand). Entropy values for 'know' factors are measured by zxcvbn at derivation time; the optional 'entropy_bits' field in factor specs is documentation only and is NOT passed to text_factor. Regenerate ONLY with a reviewed run; changing these silently breaks every derived identity.

vectors.name: strong-passphrase
vectors.note: Four strong passphrase factors, each under 80 bits individually, collectively clearing the 128-bit floor with diversity rule satisfied. Canonical derivation vector.

vectors.name: ordering-sensitivity
vectors.note: Same factors as strong-passphrase, reordered. MUST produce a DIFFERENT identity (order is part of the secret, SPEC 3.6). Verified distinct from strong-passphrase.

vectors.name: below-entropy-floor
vectors.note: Single-character factors score near zero bits each under zxcvbn measurement. Derivation MUST throw before reaching Argon2id (SPEC 3.2).
